own_solution.law: Static equilibrium: N=(12+70)g=803.6 N. Taking moments about the foot gives H L sin(theta)=g L(12/2+70*0.6)cos(theta), so H=470.4 cot(theta). The total ground force is sqrt(N^2+H^2). At theta=62 degrees, H=250.12 N and the total force is 841.62 N.
assumptions: The ladder and person are in static equilibrium.

The smooth wall supplies only a horizontal normal force.
The shutter does not contact or otherwise mechanically load the ladder.
An earlier experiment does not change the stated configuration of the present experiment.
